Package net.tnemc.paper

Class PaperItemSnapshot

java.lang.Object
net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack
net.tnemc.paper.PaperItemSnapshot
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable, net.tnemc.item.AbstractItemStack<org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>
public final class PaperItemSnapshot extends net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack
An opaque native item used when transporting existing items, including overflow. Only its amount and inventory slot are mutable. No TNIL serializer or component applicator participates in capture, copying, comparison, or persistence.
